bio_short: Matthias Brodbeck is a drummer, percussionist and teacher based in Zurich. He has played with Eddie Floyd, Lionel Hampton, Fritz Hauser and many others, and currently performs with The Stone Alphabet and the world-music quartet Saitenschlag.
video_text: Concert clips and recordings are on his YouTube channel.
about_description: Biography of the Zurich drummer and percussionist Matthias Brodbeck: studies, collaborations, projects and press kit.
cv_1: Matthias Brodbeck was born in 1971. At the age of 13 he started taking his first drum lessons with Jean-Claude Forestier from the Basel Symphony Orchestra. From 1992 to 1996 he studied at the Hochschule Luzern with Marc Halbheer and Pierre Favre. Further studies with Billy Brooks and Louis César Ewandé.
cv_2: Matthias Brodbeck was a member of the experimental rap group “P-27”, Andy Scherrer’s “Chapter 12” and the percussion trio “Metrix”.
cv_4: Currently he is a member of “The Stone Alphabet” and the world-music quartet “Saitenschlag”.
cv_5: Matthias Brodbeck lives in Zurich and works as a freelance musician and educator.
